name: Sampler+
author: pcppcp
description: Choose sampler+ in the synth type browser (Shift + T1). A sampler slot keeps its recording; from another engine it becomes a sampler with whatever sample that slot holds. It stays a normal sampler sound, with sampler+'s settings saved alongside. Without sampler+ in your build the recording plays through the stock sampler; its extras come back when you install it again.
credits: From op1r, ported to kennel by Hundekraft
